problem: The axes are set with x measured from the vertical centre line, so the centroid's x-coordinate on those axes is x̄ = 0, not 50 mm. The answer then says '50 mm from the vertical centre line, i.e. on the centre line', which contradicts itself: 50 mm from a line is not on it. A student cannot tell which reference the 50 mm belongs to.
fix: Either keep x from the vertical centre line and write x̄ = 0 mm by symmetry, or measure x from the left edge of the flange and write x̄ = 50 mm. State it once, e.g. 'Take x from the left edge of the 100 mm flange; by symmetry the centroid lies on the vertical centre line, 50 mm from that edge.' Then close with: 'The centroid is 67.8 mm above the bottom of the web, on the vertical centre line (x̄ = 50 mm from the left edge of the flange).'

problem: The table title gives units for the area column (mm²) and the last column (10³ mm³) but not for the middle column, which holds ȳ in mm. A reader has to guess the units of the 40, 90 and 67.8 entries.
fix: Title it 'T-section table: A in mm², ȳ in mm, Aȳ in 10³ mm³' so every column's unit is stated.
